why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Water and Wine'  professionally managed by Stay on 30A a coastal retreat designed for gathering, unwinding, and soaking in the best of 30A living. Perfectly situated within the private, gated community of WaterSound, this five-bedroom, 5.5-bath home sleeps up to 12 guests and offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. From the moment you arrive, the relaxed elegance of Water and Wine invites you to slow down and truly embrace vacation mode. Mornings are best spent sipping coffee on the outdoor patio while the neighborhood wakes around you. By midday, you can choose your own adventure cool off in your private pool, take a quick ride to one of the beautiful WaterSound community pools, or hop on the bikes for a breezy trip to the private beach access just minutes away.. Head up to the top level in the evening for a special treat of sweeping Gulf views that make sunset hour feel extra magical. Whether you’re enjoying a quiet drink, taking family photos, or simply letting the ocean breeze wash over you, it’s the perfect way to end the day. Exploring the area is effortless with eight adult bikes included with your stay. Ride over to The Big Chill, a lively gathering spot for dining, shopping, live music, and outdoor movies that’s perfect for guests of all ages. Beyond that, 30A’s scenic bike trails, charming beach towns, and world-class dining are all at your fingertips. Back at the house, evenings can be spent grilling and dining, swapping stories by the pool, or cozying up for a movie night. Every detail of Water and Wine is designed to make your stay feel easy, refreshing, and memorable whether you’re here for a week of family fun or a relaxing getaway with friends. With private beach access, a prime WaterSound location, and the perfect mix of private and community amenities, Water and Wine offers everything you need for a quintessential 30A vacation plus those Gulf views you’ll dream about long after you leave.
